answer: Do the arithmetic first. One honest name locks 25 POA for 2 epochs. A farmer minting 10 names locks 250 POA, and the tenth bond is frozen for 64 epochs, because the lock doubles per extra name from the same funder — 2, 4, 8, capped at 64. A hundred names means 2,500 POA locked on the mesa, the public bond registry. Then the velvet audit: each epoch 5% of names face three rotating auditors, and one failed check slashes the funder's whole chain, not one name. The forge mints exactly one credential per locked bond, so splitting money never multiplies seats. Cheap once, ruinous at scale.
